text:
You need help finding yearly commercial real estate capital values and growth figures for retail, office, and industrial property back to 1990.

I’m Mina Castellan, and with 5 years of experience in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization, I can help structure and compare this data clearly over time.

In a recent project, Parent survey analysis for Riverbend Education Fund, I cleaned and weighted a 4,200-response parent survey and wrote the findings for the board; 3 findings were adopted in the next funding plan.

For your commercial real estate research, I can help gather, organize, and build a clear year-by-year view so you can track capital values and growth trends by sector.

Do you already have a preferred data source for the commercial property markets, or would you like me to help identify one?
